Subject: Re: [opensuse] Syncing Blackberry on Linux

Funambol is fine if you are "standalone", but what if you are (like me)
using a company owned blackberry which is configured to work with their
exchange server and all you want to do is keep things like your tasks
and phone book synced on your linux laptop?
A WAY nicer thing would be a way to use my bb in places where there is
no internet for access to the internet via wireless (no matter how slow).
wcn
